feature_title: Interactive Dashboard Table — Cell Drilldown (Log Explorer)

rationale.edition: All changed paths live in OSS-owned locations — web/src/**, src/api/search/**, src/config/src/meta/**, scripts/translations/** and tests/ui-testing/** — with none under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/. No enterprise keywords (SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) appear in any changed path or symbol, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: No skip markers present: trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are empty and no tests-added label was passed. The change adds a genuine user-facing UI flow, not docs-only or CI-only, so the skip gate does not apply.
rationale.e2e: The change adds a new user-facing interaction in web/src — a per-cell drilldown search icon in dashboard table panels (TableRenderer.vue) that opens a new DashboardLogDrawer with SQL toggle, Run, Open-in-Logs, and an editable time-range control, and syncs cell_* URL params on open/close. E2E is warranted to verify this drilldown flow end to end.
rationale.area: The bulk of the UI changes live under web/src/components/dashboards/, web/src/composables/dashboard/, and web/src/views/Dashboards/, and the spec sits in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/. Dashboards is the correct area.
rationale.group: The diff adds interactive-dashboard-table.spec.js to the run_files of the Dashboards-Tables matrix shard (the ci_matrix.json change appends it alongside dashboard-pivot-table.spec.js and dashboard-table-*.spec.js), whose actual_folder is Dashboards. Dashboards-Tables is the matching shard.
rationale.existing_tests: A new Playwright E2E spec tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/interactive-dashboard-table.spec.js is added and directly covers the new cell-drilldown drawer flow (7 tests: drilldown icon visibility, drawer open with results, cell_* URL sync, SQL toggle/run, Open-in-Logs control, time-range control, and param cleanup on close). The changed usePanelDrilldown.spec.ts is a Vitest unit test and is NOT E2E coverage; configPanelHelpers.js and dashboard-cell-explorer.js are helpers/page objects, not E2E specs.
